theme_notes: Original white-stone high-fantasy human capital board with blue-and-gold banners, canals, cathedral-like spires, and fortified walls. Inspired by Stormwind mood without copying specific World of Warcraft layouts, logos, emblems, named buildings, characters, or exact silhouettes.
notes: The visible active road is composited from BoardView path cell centers.
Enemy movement, non-buildable path cells, and map contract use the same path_cells.
The style source may include decorative plazas, but only the composited main road is the gameplay path.
